title: Amsterdam 'secret space program' symposium talk on UFOs and the Kennedy assassination

tellings.quote: assumption is because of a presentation I did in Amsterdam uh around 200 I don't remember 2007 8 n something like that early 2000s um on the the secret space program was the name of this of this thing

plain: Peter Levenda, an author presented as a historian, says that sometime around 2007 or 2008 he gave a talk in Amsterdam at a gathering called the secret space program, linking UFOs and the assassination of President Kennedy. Speaking to podcast host Jesse Michels, he says people's assumptions about his views trace back to that presentation, and he mentions two other writers in the field, Richard Dolan and Timothy Good.
